summary: Backend-only testing of the Quotex Telegram-bot strategy engine. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_strategies.py (pytest, 25 tests across 7 classes). All 25 tests PASSED. Verified: 86-strategy POOL with unique names; STRATEGIES registry has exactly {'classic','quantum_prime'} with correct min_confidence (55/72); classic_momentum keeps the original pressure/momentum/wick/streak blend & 95% cap; quantum_prime returns None for <70 candles and on 200 synthetic 1m candles returns dict with direction/confidence/reason/layers_passed/selected(10-25)/agree; strong selectivity (trend 39/60 emit >=72%, random-walk 0/60); analysis.analyze() dispatcher routes to the saved strategy and attaches 'strategy' + 'strategy_key'; storage defaults {'mtg':'MTG-1','strategy':'classic'} + merge + persistence works; bot.settings_view / strategy_view / strategy_about_view all render correctly with 'set|strat', 'st|<key>', 'sti|<key>' callbacks and an active-strategy tick; sessions.ANALYSIS_CANDLES==200 & CHART_CANDLES==60 and SessionManager._pick_best() returns a result whose strategy field follows the saved setting under both classic and quantum_prime; charting.render_chart still works on 60 candles; every backend module (analysis, strategies, indicators_py, storage, sessions, bot) imports cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: Honest-implementation notes are correctly documented in the Quantum Prime 'about' text (volume=range proxy; news layer is a shock filter). This matches the request's expectations.
layer 21 'final probability score' is implicitly counted by quantum_prime as layers_passed = computed_passes + 1; this is documented via the +1 in reason text. Consistent with the design note.
sessions._pick_best() calls analysis.analyze() with strategy=st AND passes only CLOSED candles (drops the running minute) — good; prevents look-ahead bias.
bot.py resolves BOT_TOKEN/ADMIN_ID at import time via config.py — testing had to inject dummy env vars, which the request explicitly allowed. Not a defect.
No dead-code or duplication issues found in strategies.py/_layers()/quantum_prime; POOL builder cleanly uses default-arg closures to bind loop vars.

success_rate.frontend: N/A - frontend testing skipped per request

test_credentials: Not applicable - dummy env vars used (BOT_TOKEN=x, ADMIN_ID=1, QUOTEX_EMAIL=a@b.c, QUOTEX_PASSWORD=p). Real Telegram/Quotex was NOT contacted.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic OHLC candle dicts generated on the fly by _trend()/_random_walk() helpers inside test_strategies.py. No files written outside the restored settings.json.
selectivity_measurement: quantum_prime emitted >=72% confidence on 39/60 strong-trend scenarios and 0/60 random-walk scenarios (60 trials each, seeds 0-59 / 1000-1059). Confirms genuine selectivity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This repo is a standalone Python Telegram bot (no FastAPI/React, no MongoDB). Do NOT call supervisorctl restart backend/frontend. Test via imports + pytest. Use dummy env vars (BOT_TOKEN=x ADMIN_ID=1 QUOTEX_EMAIL=a@b.c QUOTEX_PASSWORD=p) so config.py loads. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_strategies.py — it already covers registry, classic, quantum_prime shape+selectivity, dispatcher, persistence, bot UI callbacks, session wiring, and no-regression imports. After tests, restore /app/backend/data/settings.json to {'mtg':'MTG-1','strategy':'classic'}.
